program.name: International Bachelor Econometrics and Operations Research

requirement.applicantContext: IB Diploma applicants to the International Bachelor Econometrics and Operations Research for 2027–2028.
requirement.subjectNotes: Mathematics: Analysis and Approaches HL requires 5. Analysis and Approaches SL at 6 or higher allows the student to take the maths entrance exam. Applications and Interpretation provides insufficient mathematical preparation. English A requires HL 4 or SL 5, or English B requires HL 5.
requirement.conditions: Count the six subject grades only. The listed 30 points are the eligibility minimum before individual selection; TOK, Extended Essay and CAS are excluded.
